# Feature: Telegram Inbox E2E (Integration Core Step 02)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-04 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Replace the task-placeholder Inbox with a real messaging inbox for **one channel slice**: Telegram Bot.
Connect bot token → sync inbound updates → list conversations → open thread → reply via outbox → show delivery status/errors.
**Product goal** (broader): omnichannel = many accounts incl. **personal** Telegram DMs → **step 02b** (Unipile user session). This ticket = Bot proof only.
Roadmap: Inbox P1 (Stufe A) — first real channel E2E

## Preconditions
- Step 01 Connection Core migrated (`connections`, credentials, bindings, sync_cursors)
- Owner/Admin can manage credentials; Editor+ can reply if bound
- Valid Telegram bot token available for live probe (tests may mock `fetch`)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Migration adds inbox tables: conversations, messages, contact_identities, outbox_jobs (+ indexes / unique provider_message_id)
- [ ] POST connect Telegram bot stores encrypted token, sets capabilities, binds inbox read_dm+send_dm+sync
- [ ] POST sync pulls getUpdates (cursor), upserts conversations/messages idempotently (dedupe by provider_message_id)
- [ ] GET conversations + GET messages return tenant-scoped Dark-Ops-ready payloads
- [ ] POST reply enqueues outbox → sendMessage → delivery status sent|failed; one outbox job per reply attempt
- [ ] Inbox UI: three-pane desktop (list / thread / context stub); connect + sync actions; loading/empty/error
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Invalid bot token → connect fails closed (no orphan connection with active status)
- [ ] Duplicate sync of same update → no duplicate messages
- [ ] Reply without send_dm capability / revoked connection → 409
- [ ] Cross-tenant conversation id → 404
- [ ] Outbox send failure marks job failed + message delivery_status failed (no silent success)
- [ ] Viewer cannot connect; can read if membership allows list (member read)

## Regression
- [ ] Task “Meine Aufgaben” still reachable via Projects (not removed from ProjectsShell)
- [ ] Connection Core mock routes still work
- [ ] Sidebar Inbox nav still present

## Assumptions
- Polling via getUpdates (offset cursor) for V1; webhook optional later
- contact_identities created for telegram user id with confidence `high` on telegram:user_id; CRM customer link deferred to step 04 (nullable customer_id)
- Customer context pane shows identity stub + link to Kunden when customerId present
- Screenshots: desktop list+thread after sync (verify-ui later)
